title: AnalyticsCoworkMetrics

action_count.title: Action Count
action_count.description: Number of tool actions completed in Cowork sessions

artifacts_created_count.title: Artifacts Created Count
artifacts_created_count.description: Number of artifacts created in Cowork sessions: an artifact counts once, on the day a session first saves it. Counted from 2026-08-17; 0 on earlier days. Exact in date-range mode: a creation belongs to exactly one day, so the per-day counts never overlap and their sum over the window is the exact count of distinct creations in it.

connectors_used_count.title: Connectors Used Count
connectors_used_count.description: Total number of connector invocations in Cowork sessions

dispatch_turn_count.title: Dispatch Turn Count
dispatch_turn_count.description: Number of Dispatch (background agent) turns completed

distinct_connectors_used_count.title: Distinct Connectors Used Count
distinct_connectors_used_count.description: Number of distinct connectors used in Cowork sessions. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

distinct_plugins_used_count.title: Distinct Plugins Used Count
distinct_plugins_used_count.description: Number of distinct plugins used in Cowork sessions. Null while Cowork plugin-use metrics are not enabled for this organization. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

distinct_session_count.title: Distinct Session Count
distinct_session_count.description: Number of distinct Cowork sessions. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

distinct_skills_used_count.title: Distinct Skills Used Count
distinct_skills_used_count.description: Number of distinct skills used in Cowork sessions. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

edit_tool_count.title: Edit Tool Count
edit_tool_count.description: Number of successful Edit tool calls in Cowork sessions. Null while the file-edit metrics are not enabled for this organization.

file_edit_count.title: File Edit Count
file_edit_count.description: Number of successful file-edit tool calls (Edit, MultiEdit, Write, NotebookEdit) in Cowork sessions. Null, never 0, while the file-edit metrics are not enabled for this organization.

message_count.title: Message Count
message_count.description: Number of messages sent in Cowork sessions

multi_edit_tool_count.title: Multi Edit Tool Count
multi_edit_tool_count.description: Number of successful MultiEdit tool calls in Cowork sessions. Null while the file-edit metrics are not enabled for this organization.

notebook_edit_tool_count.title: Notebook Edit Tool Count
notebook_edit_tool_count.description: Number of successful NotebookEdit tool calls in Cowork sessions. Null while the file-edit metrics are not enabled for this organization.

plugins_used_count.title: Plugins Used Count
plugins_used_count.description: Total number of plugin invocations in Cowork sessions. Null while Cowork plugin-use metrics are not enabled for this organization.

sessions_with_file_edits_count.title: Sessions With File Edits Count
sessions_with_file_edits_count.description: Number of distinct Cowork sessions with at least one successful file-edit tool call. Null while the file-edit metrics are not enabled for this organization. Approximate (HLL, typical error <2%) in date-range mode. Null on aggregated rows where a distinct count cannot be computed.

skills_used_count.title: Skills Used Count
skills_used_count.description: Total number of skill invocations in Cowork sessions

write_tool_count.title: Write Tool Count
write_tool_count.description: Number of successful Write tool calls in Cowork sessions. Null while the file-edit metrics are not enabled for this organization.

description: Cowork activity metrics for a single user on a given day.
